description: Portable bac/1 handshake examples. Each case sends an invoke with id case.name, channel bac:hello, params case.params, plus situation.frame members. connection=negotiated means a valid hello already succeeded. identityStorage selects a storage fault; omitted means available. Substitute placeholders recursively as whole JSON values.

placeholders.$HOST_ID: The synthetic identity of the host under test: h_ followed by 32 lowercase hex digits. Use an identity different from h_ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff.
placeholders.$BUILD: The complete build object of the host under test.
